name: Newsroom Evidence
tagline: A newspaper-inspired evidence report with masthead, documentary photography, source-aware table, chart, interpretation and explicit limitations.

palette.description: Newsprint white, dark forest ink and muted brown editorial labels.

typography.style: High-contrast newspaper serif headlines with compact modern reporting text.

best_for: Evidence-led reports that need methods, data, images, source context, limitations and a defensible editorial takeaway.
avoid_for: Unverified claims presented as fact, glossy sales pitches or sparse motivational keynotes.
